content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

This is a sovereign commerce stack. It gives digital creators in restricted regions a way to sell products without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad. The stack is built on free, globally accessible tools. GitHub Pages hosts your store. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee. You own the entire stack after deployment. No platform has access. No subscriptions. No dependency on third-party services that can shut you down.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-4|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-behind-bitcoin-payments-digital-downloads-stripe-8|The Real]] is modular and decentralized. Your storefront is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. These tools handle order processing, file delivery, and payment verification. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets. Files are delivered from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. NOWPayments integrates via webhook. When a buyer sends crypto, NOWPayments verifies the payment on-chain and fires the webhook. Your backend logic confirms the order and delivers the product. The entire process is automatic. No manual intervention required.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, or other digital products, this stack is for you. It’s designed for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines. These regions face payment rejection, currency collapse, and financial isolation. This stack gives you infrastructure sovereignty. You own the tools. You control the process. You’re not renting—you’re building.
USDT on Tron costs under $0.10 per transaction. Solana fees are fractions of a cent. Affordable crypto payments for everyone.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack combines free, globally accessible tools with NOWPayments’ crypto payment gateway. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosts your static site. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets stores order data. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee. The webhook integration ensures automatic payment verification and product delivery. USDT on Tron costs under $0.10 per transaction. Solana fees average fractions of a cent. These networks make crypto payments affordable and fast. The stack is designed for low-cost, high-efficiency operation.

Start by choosing your stack components. Decide between GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting. Select Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic. Choose Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Set up the webhook to automate payment verification and product delivery. Test the entire flow end-to-end. Deploy your stack. Load your products. Start selling. NOWPayments integration allows you to receive crypto payments for digital products without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad. It works by verifying payments on-chain and firing a webhook to your backend logic. This triggers automatic product delivery. USDT payments on Tron cost under $0.10 per transaction. Solana fees are fractions of a cent. Compared to PayPal, USDT payments arrive in minutes, not days. Creators in Nigeria can convert Bitcoin to naira using P2P exchanges like Binance or Patricia.
